# Leadership Team Portraits Directory

Place approved high-resolution executive portrait photos here in the future:
- `arshad-alam-shaikh.jpg` - Founder & Chairman (Arshad Alam Shaikh)
- `eng-bakhteyar-alam.jpg` - Chief Operating Officer (Eng. Bakhteyar Alam)
- `eng-nadeem-akhtar.jpg` - Chief Financial Officer (Eng. Nadeem Akhtar)

When new photos are added, you can simply update `index.html` by placing `<img src="/assets/team/filename.jpg" alt="..." class="leader-img">` inside the `.leader-portrait-frame` elements, and update `src/scripts/data.js` accordingly.
